trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for completing the mission 'Breakfast Run'. Just play the story — it pops at the mission's end. No preparation, no missable step.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for completing 'The Cartel Heist'. Treat it as your rehearsal for the bank vault jobs in Maximum Withdrawal: watch how the crew splits the haul and plans the escape, because the optional vault robberies later use the same rhythm — heavy bags, a partner to share the load, and 4 stars on the way out.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for completing the mission 'Child's Play'. Just play the story — it pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for completing the mission 'Headliners'. Just play the story — it pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for completing the mission 'VCIA Takedown'. It takes place at the airport — and the same airport is where the Catch Me If You Can trophy lives, so while you are here, learn the layout of the gates and fences for later.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for completing the mission 'Operation Savage Glory'. Just play the story — it pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Five missions in order: 'Climbing the Cellerichain', 'Pay the Cellerica Fee', 'Peach!', 'Read the Label', then 'Puff Puff Pass' — finish the last one and the trophy pops. Andy does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so do his strand for its own sake.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand is the treasure hunt: 7 shipwrecks to dive. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig up the treasure. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so do not panic if he goes quiet — the strand resumes. Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. Finish his final mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs run out of the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, available after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Work through all five; the fifth, 'Hometown Heroes', awards the trophy. The jobs are still available after the story, so there is no rush — but they are a good early source of cash and chaos while you are in the area.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner ('Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS'). He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City. Scan cars with WAiNK to see if they are on his list before you steal one — hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best hunting ground, and better condition pays more. Deliver the sixteenth and finish his final mission for the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason-only. After 'Here, Kitty Kitty' in Chapter 3, synthetic labs marked in purple appear around Vice City — destroy them, then play the finale 'Shut Down the Labs' to close the strand and pop the trophy. Tyrone does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when he texts Jason. 'Veteran Hunted' in Lummox County is the first. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks and bring them back as Jason — a clean one-shot kill pays more, but it is not required for the trophy. Which animal triggers Fair Game is not confirmed yet, so the guide says so honestly; work through the decks and it will land. 100% completion needs all 15 Target Decks, so this strand feeds the platinum twice.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.guide: Nine activity types, one try each: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race all count), and a stunt. None of them needs to be mastered — just sampled. Most players tick off half of these naturally in the first chapters; run down the rest in one free-roam session and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: 14 drone race locations, 42 races in total — but the trophy only needs one win at each location. Learn the drone's handling on the first few races, then sweep the map location by location. 100% completion wants all 42 races won, so keep racing past the trophy if you are chasing the platinum.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the payoff, not a task of its own: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no shortcut — expect roughly 200 hours across story, side strands and the 100% checklist. Work the three roadmap phases in order (story, then the 100% grind, then strangers and clean-up) and let the platinum land when the last straggler falls. If one trophy is holding you back, the Next up planner ranks what to chase first.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The big grind. 100% needs, in full: every robbery including 8 vault heists and all 39 gang operations, every underwater discovery, a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge, every Top Fun drone race win, and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. The partials: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Track it all in the pause menu under Progress — nothing here is missable, so chip away at it after the story and let the counters guide you.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The story finale. It pops when the last mission ends, so it cannot be missed — but there is no mission replay and no New Game+, so finish everything else you care about before you start it. Keep a dedicated save at the start of the final stretch (one save per chapter start is the habit to build) so you can go back and mop up afterwards without replaying the whole game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count — 130 jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. The quickest route is flying under bridges: grab a fast plane, chain the bridge gaps, and watch the counter climb. The map shows every Stunt Spot, and Progress > Activities > Stunts tracks your total. You do not need the optional challenge on each stunt. 100% completion wants 300, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing the platinum.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: 42 gold medals across 12 shooting ranges. There is no shortcut here — visit every range on the map, work through its challenges, and gold each one. Take your time and learn each challenge's rhythm rather than rushing; misses cost more time than a steady pace. The range counter in Progress shows which challenges are still short of gold. Also required in full for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open through the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…'. Follow a security van to its bank, then hit the vault — the haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner to carry it out. Expect 4 stars every time, so plan your escape route before you go in. Each vault pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 if you want the next target handed to you. Five vaults, five clean getaways.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger mission strands, finished end to end. Confirmed to count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. Confirmed NOT to count: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie — their strands feed other trophies instead. The time-sensitive one is Yago's Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 (hourglass icon): do it the moment it appears, and save first. Which strands make up the remaining count is still being confirmed — the guide says so honestly; watch the in-game trophy progress counter as you finish strands to see what ticks it up.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are scattered across Leonida; a set is complete when every card in it is found. Three full sets is the target — work through the sets one at a time and use the in-game collection tracker (Progress > Collections) to see which cards you are still missing rather than wandering blind. Cards are a long-tail collectible, so fold the hunt into your exploration and mop up the last few with the tracker once the story is done.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Hold Up on the D-pad, then R1/RB, to WAiNK a location. The 100 you need come from 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags — scan anything that glints as you travel and the count climbs on its own. 100% completion wants 100 scans too, so this trophy and the platinum checklist overlap exactly. WAiNK also scans vehicles and cars on wish lists, so keep the habit everywhere.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story mission, unmissable: play through 'Gone Fishing' and the trophy pops at the end of the mission. It also introduces Cal, who matters later — after this mission he texts you about fishing spots, which feeds the Baited My Tackle trophy. Nothing to prepare; just play the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Chapter trophies pop at the chapter boundary — this one lands when Chapter 2 begins. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing that does not come back: Lucia's balcony meditation the morning after 'Down to Earth' (see Positive Mental Attitude). Keep a save at the start of every chapter as a matter of habit.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy, published with the name censored as 'T**s' on PlayStation — that is how the official list prints it, and this guide keeps it as published. It pops after 'Welcome to Vice City', as Chapter 3 begins. Chapter 2 is where the world opens up: Coffee Break unlocks character switching, Bret's hunting texts start, and the Thrillbilly Mudclub jobs become available.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. It pops after 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life', as Chapter 4 begins. Chapter 3 is the busiest for side content: Andy texts Lucia, Tyrone's labs appear for Jason, Randy's Wish List opens once you have the Key Cloner, and Yago's time-sensitive race shows up — do that race the moment you see its hourglass icon.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 4 — the chapter where the vault jobs open up (see Maximum Withdrawal) and the endgame begins to take shape. If you have been keeping one save per chapter start, this is the point where that habit pays off: the final stretch is near, and you will want a way back to mop up anything left.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: 20 different races out of 40 — winning the same race twice does not count. Mix car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races to spread the wins around; each new race you win ticks the counter. If you are also chasing Top Fun, its 14 locations knock out a big chunk of this list at the same time.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui', he texts you and marks a fishing spot. Play through his fishing quests and then beat him in his challenge — learn the fishing rhythm (steady tension, reel in the windows) and do not rush the catch. It is a one-off challenge, not a grind.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play one arcade game through to the end. There are 3 games on the TV at home — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — plus Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick the one you enjoy most and finish a run; it also ticks one of the nine activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE only possibly-missable trophy — read this before you finish Chapter 1. Lucia can meditate on her balcony the morning after 'Down to Earth', and that spot disappears after Chapter 1. Whether the Chapter 1 spot is required for the trophy is not yet confirmed, so do it while you can and do not risk it. Meditate at 18 spots in total; meditating with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last spot needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track your count under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: 50 of the 80 Challenges. Progress > Challenges marks finished ones with a tick, so work through the list and pick the ones that suit how you play — driving, combat, exploration and stunts all have their own. 100% completion wants 70, so keep going past 50 if you are chasing the platinum.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You need both characters together, so this only opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you — bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so they are the reliable way up — then lose the heat: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters. Once the stars are gone and you are clear, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shops, back to back, with your partner, without ever losing your Wanted Level. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City are close together — they open up after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — so hit them in one run. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop; if it still has not popped, rob a fourth. Keep the pace quick and do not stop to fight.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 vehicles with WAiNK — you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan everything that passes; variety helps, so work different districts and vehicle types rather than one intersection. It pairs naturally with the WAiNK habit from You WAiNKer!, and feeds the 200-of-277 vehicle scans that 100% completion wants.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is clicking both sticks while aiming. Fill your Focus first — eat, drink and wash up at home, and Adrenaline extends it — then find a dense group of enemies and drop five with an assault rifle before Focus runs out. Gang operation thugs count; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to. A gang operation is the best stage: plenty of thugs, no wanted level spiral.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: You need the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. Use it on the locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm — then slip inside, find the note with the safe code in the back room, and clean out the safe without ever being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well. Slow and quiet beats fast and loud.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, box it in so it cannot drive off, then crack the back doors with a sticky bomb and take the cash. If trucks are being stubborn, a bank vault robbery and escape counts too — the game accepts either route. Either way, plan the getaway before you strike: the truck job is quick, the escape is the hard part.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map. The quickest way is by plane: fly a grid over the state and watch the map fill in. It is pure exploration — no combat, no collectibles required — so do it in one relaxed session once you have a plane, ideally while you are already travelling for other trophies.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: One illegal operation per gang, and there are 9 gangs — the yellow map icons mark the operations. Progress > Gangs keeps count of which gangs you have hit, so check it before you travel: no point robbing the same gang twice. 100% completion needs all 39 operations, so keep hitting them after this trophy pops.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First get the Dye Pack Jammer from 'Credit Check' (Meet Raul's Crew, Chapter 3) — without it, marked bills are just paper. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Marked bills come from bank vault jobs, Payday Loans and other robberies, so this is a running total that grows alongside your other robbery trophies — $250,000 will arrive on its own if you keep robbing and fencing.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across all shops — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest ways to burn through it. This is one of those trophies that pops on its own if you play normally and actually buy things; if you are close near the end, a round of car mods or a weapon shopping spree closes the gap in one visit.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Eight garages to buy in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which opens after 'Daily Driver' in Chapter 2. About $160,000 in total. The four story garages do not count toward this one — only the eight you buy yourself. Garages are also practical (storage for the cars you register for On the Spot), so buy them as you need space and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Steal a vehicle, take it to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray it and register it. At first only cars without trackers can be registered; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones too. You need free garage space, and each registration costs money — so use cheap cars and bikes, ten of them, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a big passenger jet docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence, use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge, get aboard and take off. Once you are about a kilometre away, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Head to Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County — the tanks sit at the south end of the base. Get into a Rhino tank and make it yours; the base is guarded, so expect a fight on the way in and a chase on the way out. The trophy's description is a joke about the heat — the method is a straightforward military-base steal.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down — the guide says so honestly rather than inventing a method. The official description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: the best reading is a bar or beachfront spot along Ocean Beach where you can order a drink and take in the view. Try the beachfront bars as either character and see which one triggers it; if you find the exact spot, note it in the trophy's note field for your own run.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down — the guide says so honestly rather than inventing a method. The official description points at a vehicle showroom: the best reading is driving a car straight through a showroom's glass front and out the other side, in the classic style the description hints at. Pick a showroom with a clear run-up and a big front window; if you find the exact trigger, note it in the trophy's note field.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation, first marked by 'Hit Kingpin Bowling' in Chapter 2. Three valuables inside: a luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and a safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three valuables in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back, so grab what you can while you are there.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (pause menu > Jason & Lucia > Strength). Work out at fitness clubs — find them under Map > Activities — and bring your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story, you can train at home. It is a slow burn, so fold gym sessions into your routine between missions rather than grinding it in one sitting.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 500 Criminal Profile actions. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI) so you can watch the count climb — most players earn this without trying, just by playing the game the way the game wants. One warning: an irredeemable criminal profile is permanent, so do not push toward it deliberately; let the count build through normal play.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down — the guide says so honestly rather than inventing a method. The official description, 'Second time's the charm', suggests retrying something that failed the first time: the best reading is a second attempt at an activity or challenge after a failed first run. If you fail something and the trophy pops on the retry, that was it — note the exact trigger in the trophy's note field for your own run.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down — the guide says so honestly rather than inventing a method. The official description, 'What the hell just happened?', points at something strange or unexpected — the kind of odd, one-off event players stumble into rather than plan. Keep exploring the odd corners of Leonida and it will likely find you; if it pops, note where you were in the trophy's note field.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down — the guide says so honestly rather than inventing a method. The official description points at a melee drive-by at a bowling alley: the best reading is striking down bowling pins — or bowlers — with a melee attack from a moving vehicle near a bowling alley, Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn being the obvious stage. Try a slow drive-by with a melee weapon there; if you find the exact trigger, note it in the trophy's note field.
